recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied value set correction for the directly related active Procedure example without broadening the scope to cleanup of the standalone local device-action CodeSystem or unrelated Procedure issues.
issue_request: FHIR-32513 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core Procedure issue requesting that the overly broad intensional Procedure deviceAction value set be replaced with four enumerated SNOMED CT codes: 129336009 Implantation, 278312000 Reattachment, 282089006 Replacement, and 129303008 Removal.
initial_application: The Jira-linked GH commit 1c3625010a99e556dceb214ccadaedd0819dcdd8 changed source/procedure/valueset-device-action.xml from a SNOMED CT is-a filter to the four requested SNOMED CT concepts, but it did not update the active Procedure implant example, which still used the older local http://hl7.org/fhir/device-action code "implanted" for Procedure.focalDevice.action.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Procedure as an active approved resource, and source/procedure/list-Procedure-examples.xml includes procedure-example-implant. Procedure.focalDevice.action has a preferred binding to the updated device-action value set, so the implant example should use SNOMED CT 129336009 when that exact requested concept is available. Community searches found no later decision reversing or narrowing the Jira resolution.
reconciliation: Changed source/procedure/procedure-example-implant.xml so Procedure.focalDevice.action uses system http://snomed.info/sct, code 129336009, and display Implantation. The value set source was already correctly enumerated and was not changed.
source_changes: source/procedure/procedure-example-implant.xml: replaced the focalDevice.action coding from http://hl7.org/fhir/device-action#implanted with SNOMED CT 129336009 "Implantation".
